pr_title: chore(android): align android context options with mixin

issue_context.title: Android launchBrowser options not working
issue_context.body:
Hey guys,

Fantastic work overall! I can't believe how far this library has advanced over just a few months.

I was wondering if anyone has tested the options in the launchBrowser context. https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-androiddevice
None of them is working for me, i.e. I tried changing the geo or the colorScheme but didn't work.

Let me know if anyone can help
comments: Hey! Yeah there was a bug that they were not being forwarded correctly. In the meantime until its fixed [page.emulateMedia](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-emulate-media) should work.

review_comments: Mixed feelings about it: we'd rather see users emulate android using linux than emulate android device using android.
